overview: This enum puts quick chat lines into the conversation, tactics, or unique tab.

None.simple: This marks a chat row with no chat tab.
None.technical: EGameChatCategory::None is the constructor default for FGameDataTableRow_Chat::ChatCategory. UGameWidgetManager::GetChatIconSprite maps it to EGameCommonChatIconCategory::Stamp, while UGameCommonChatListWindowWidget::SetListItems installs lists only for Conversation, Tactics, and Unique.

Conversation.simple: This is the casual conversation chat tab.
Conversation.technical: UGameCommonChatListWidget::InitializeWidget groups rows into ChatListItemDataMap by ChatCategory, and SetupChatList carries that key to the chat window. UGameCommonChatListWindowWidget::SetListItems installs this group in ConversationChatList, and GetChatIconSprite maps it to EGameCommonChatIconCategory::Conversation.

Tactics.simple: This is the tactics chat tab.
Tactics.technical: UGameCommonChatListWidget groups these rows under this category key and filters them by the lobby or interval enable flag before passing them on. UGameCommonChatListWindowWidget::SetListItems installs the group in TacticsChatList, and GetChatIconSprite maps the category to EGameCommonChatIconCategory::Tactics.

Unique.simple: This is the unique character chat tab.
Unique.technical: UGameCommonChatListWidget places these rows in their own category map entry, and UGameCommonChatListWindowWidget::SetListItems installs that group in UniqueChatList. GetChatIconSprite maps the category to EGameCommonChatIconCategory::Unique before any provocation or respect label override is applied.

Invalid.simple: This is an undefined chat tab.
Invalid.technical: EGameChatCategory::Invalid has no explicit case in GetChatIconSprite, so it leaves the icon category at EGameCommonChatIconCategory::None. No list is installed for it in SetListItems, and no exported Chat row uses the value, so authored placement cannot be claimed.

notes: ChatCategory is stored on FGameDataTableRow_Chat and is used as the key for grouping lobby and interval chat items.

GetChatIconSprite first maps ChatCategory to a base icon. Provocation_1 and Provocation_2 then set the Provocation icon, and Respect_1 and Respect_2 set the Respect icon, so the category icon can be overwritten.

Chat message, result, and battle requests write the category byte into FGameChatMessageRequest::Byte21. No reader for that field was found. StartCooldown receives the category but branches on ChatLabel instead.
The supplied Chat export uses only Conversation, Tactics, and Unique.
